# WG8 · Tài chính · Tổng quan (kế toán)

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `accountant`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#overview`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- Accountant role header "KẾ TOÁN • ĐỐI SOÁT"; sees overview, work, rates and receipts.
- Inventory note: Accountant projection: hero reads "KẾ TOÁN • ĐỐI SOÁT"; four tabs; the notification box says the accountant does not read the owner inbox.
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `accountant`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"}; it must show "KẾ TOÁN • ĐỐI SOÁT".

Kit components used: Tile×4, Card×3, Button×2, Field×1, Tabs×1, Badge×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

- (no notice or empty state on this screen)

## Business rules
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".

## Differences from the app design
- App D1 "Đối soát & thu ngân" is the accountant home with 3 tiles; the web lands the accountant on "Thu ngân" (WF1) and reaches finance from the menu.

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
